title: Design System: GPIS — Grupo de Pesquisa e Inovação em Saúde

display.purpose: One per page: home, inner and impact heroes and the closing headline. Capped at 6rem, tracking -0.038em, never tighter than -0.04em.

headline.purpose: Section titles, impact block headings, the word-by-word ink-in claim.

headline-sm.purpose: Group and theme heads, feature and reference titles, timeline years, 600-weight ledes.

title.purpose: Ruled-list row titles, facets, steps, profile names, exit values.

body.purpose: Prose at 66ch; tabular figures on globally.

label.purpose: Meta, captions, dd lines, source lines. Sentence case, never uppercase-tracked.

numeral.purpose: Credit dt values, band years, block numbers; Archivo at 82% width.

shadows.name: knockout-ring
shadows.purpose: Cuts step markers out of their progress rule (use var(--mist) on mist). Not elevation; content never carries shadows.

focus.name: focus-ring
focus.purpose: Global focus-visible ring; one of the two permitted uses of green.

effects.name: header-glass
effects.purpose: Sticky header so content passes beneath.

effects.name: duotone-feature
effects.value: img { filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.06-1.08) } + overlay { background: var(--blue); mix-blend-mode: multiply; opacity: 0.55-0.62 } over var(--navy-deep)
effects.purpose: Hero and feature photographs only; in-body activity photos stay in colour.

effects.name: gridlines
effects.value: 12 spans, border-left 1px var(--on-navy-rule) on navy; rgba(14,35,71,0.07) on white/mist
effects.purpose: Visible grid on every section, beneath content, pointer-events none.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for reveals, hovers, fills and menu (0.35-1s).

motion.name: reveal-wipe
motion.purpose: [data-reveal=wipe] left-to-right reveal of fields and images.

motion.name: parallax
motion.purpose: [data-parallax] logo mark and photographs inside fixed frames.

motion.name: scroll-progress
motion.purpose: [data-progress] timeline band cohort line, steps rule, vertical timeline.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all durations 0.01ms; no-motion and no-ink classes show final state
motion.purpose: Every effect resolves to its finished composition.

components.css: .ds-btn { --bg: var(--navy, #0E2347); --fg: #fff; --bd: var(--navy, #0E2347); --hv: var(--navy-raise, #16305B); --hvfg: #fff; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 1.375rem; background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); border: 1.5px solid var(--bd); border-radius: 0; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.005em; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; transition: color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--hv); transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: bottom; transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover::before { transform: scaleY(1); } .ds-btn:hover { color: var(--hvfg); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5FAA4E; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-i { width: 1.1em; height: 1.1em; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: square; transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-i { transform: translateX(4px); }

narrative.overview:
GPIS is set like an International Typographic Style identity manual printed on white coated stock: a strict 12-column grid that stays visible as hairlines, one grotesque family (Archivo) running flush-left from small credits to poster-scale headlines, and the logo's colours flooding whole regions edge to edge rather than tinting small chips. Navy is the territory; logo blue draws time (the timeline band, progress rules, the cohort line); green appears only where the visitor acts.

Density is deliberately uneven. Large empty navy fields carrying a single 6rem headline collide with dense, ruled lists: research-line indexes, credits tables, publication strips, numbered exits. Everything is square, flat and ruled; depth comes from colour fields and hairlines, never from shadows. Motion is the second signature: content rises, masks or wipes into place on scroll, the logo mark and photographs drift in layered parallax, the cohort line is drawn by scrolling, and a key claim inks in word by word. Every effect has a reduced-motion state that shows the final composition at once.

The system refuses the category default of a photo hero over a row of equal rounded cards, and it refuses decorative labels above headings: headlines speak first.
keyCharacteristics: Visible 12-column gridlines over every section field.
One family, Archivo, variable width: 94% for headings, 82% for numerals, tabular figures throughout.
Logo colour fields (navy, blue) at full bleed; green held back for actions.
Square corners, 1px navy hairlines, 3px blue or navy rules for emphasis.
Facts as credits tables, never hero-metric columns.
Scroll-driven motion with a complete reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The Green Means Go Rule
rules.body: Green is reserved for actions (green buttons, the header CTA, the white button's hover) and the focus ring. It never colours tags, labels, icons, rules or decoration.

rules.name: The Light Blue On Navy Rule
rules.body: On navy, every secondary accent (numerals, separators, meta, labels) is light blue. Science blue and green are not used as text accents on navy.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Field Rule
rules.body: Logo colours fill whole regions edge to edge (hero field, band, close, feature). They are not shrunk into tinted cards or badges.

rules.name: The Poster Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Display type is capped at 6rem, and no tracking goes tighter than -0.04em. Scale comes from the field around the headline, not from pushing the headline further.

rules.name: The Headline Speaks First Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow or kicker sits above a heading. Context lives in meta lines below the title or in the ruled list it introduces.

rules.name: The Visible Grid Rule
rules.body: Every section carries its 12-column gridlines: white-ink hairlines at 22% (on-navy-rule) on navy, navy at 7% (gridline-ink) on white and mist. Gridlines sit beneath content and never take pointer events. Project pages carry them throughout; on the home, impacto, pessoas, publicações and research-line pages most white and mist sections do not carry them yet, which is drift, not an exception.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. If something needs separation, give it a field colour or a rule.

rules.name: The Duotone Feature Rule
rules.body: Hero and feature photographs are duotoned: grayscale with a slight contrast boost, then a logo-blue multiply layer (55–62%) over a navy backing. In-body activity photographs stay in full colour on purpose, so people and their materials read as real.

dos: Do flood whole regions with navy or science blue and set one display headline in the empty field.
Do keep green on actions and the focus ring only; use light blue for every secondary accent on navy.
Do draw the 12-column gridlines on every section: on-navy-rule on navy, navy at 7% on white and mist.
Do present facts as a credits table (dt value, dd meaning, rows inset 16px from hairlines).
Do cap display type at 6rem and keep tracking at or above -0.04em.
Do duotone hero and feature photographs (grayscale plus logo-blue multiply) and leave in-body activity photos in colour.
Do use ruled lists with arrows and numbered exits where another site would use cards.
Do give every motion effect a reduced-motion state that shows the final composition.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
Don't show facts as a big-number hero-metric column.
Don't use green for tags, labels, rules, icons or decoration.
Don't round corners or add shadows to content.
Don't add a second typeface; vary Archivo's width and weight instead.
Don't fall back to a photo hero over a row of equal rounded cards.
